name: project-md
description: /project-md:init drafts PROJECT.md, a committed document that says what a project is for: the problem, who it's for, goals, non-goals, what success and failure look like, priorities, constraints and decisions. /project-md:review checks it against what changed since its last commit, and changes only what you approve. The plugin loads PROJECT.md into every session, with no line in CLAUDE.md.
